about: The phone's text on both engines, one table (IGL): POST /dictate with send on, to desk s1 in Terminal's tab tty:/dev/ttys003 (several lines through the clipboard, with ⌘V: Accessibility given, the Mac unlocked). Each case says the desk as both engines have it (desk), what reads the tab (front), what the stand-in terminal does once its last check lets the paste go (terminal), the states the Mac app hears when it asks (asked: the Swift engine's own sessions, or the Go core's over the bridge), the request the Go core sends and the Mac app's answer, and what the phone is told by each engine. PhoneMicTests.swift runs every case through the Mac app's bridge, its phone-text action (Deck.typePhoneWords); desktop/phonetext_test.go runs it through the Go core with a stand-in Mac app giving the fixture's answer. What the Swift engine told the phone until 1.25.0 (swift) stays as the Go core's reference: they differ only where the words may have typed, the Swift engine's 503 with its sentence, the Go core's 502 pasteUnsaid. Something is typed only where typed says so, and a Return goes only after it (returns).
